info.title: Pitch
info.synopsis: Ginny Baker diventa la prima donna a giocare nel campionato di baseball della Major League con la squadra dei San Diego Padres.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.plot: A young pitcher adjusts to life in the spotlight after making history as the first woman to play Major League Baseball.

translations.value: A young pitcher adjusts to life in the spotlight after making history as the first woman to play Major League Baseball.

episodes.name: The Interim
episodes.plot: Ginny tries to fit in with the team despite the resurfacing of a sexist comment made by Al. Mike copes with the end of his marriage and mortality of his career. Blip faces the fallout of Evelyn defending him to the media.

translations.value: Ginny tries to fit in with the team despite the resurfacing of a sexist comment made by Al. Mike copes with the end of his marriage and mortality of his career. Blip faces the fallout of Evelyn defending him to the media.

episodes.name: Beanball
episodes.plot: The Padres play against the Cardinals, whose pitcher broke Tommy's finger during a fight. Ginny realizes that her ex-boyfriend is on the opposing team. Al asks an old friend to help save his job.

translations.value: The Padres play against the Cardinals, whose pitcher broke Tommy's finger during a fight. Ginny realizes that her ex-boyfriend is on the opposing team. Al asks an old friend to help save his job.

episodes.name: The Break
episodes.plot: Mike sustains an injury that threatens his spot in the MLB All-Star Game. Ginny attempts to balance her career and personal life. The Padres are blindsided when Oscar signs a star catcher from Cuba.

translations.value: Mike sustains an injury that threatens his spot in the MLB All-Star Game. Ginny attempts to balance her career and personal life. The Padres are blindsided when Oscar signs a star catcher from Cuba.

episodes.name: Alfonzo Guzman-Chavez
episodes.plot: Mike sustains an injury that threatens his spot in the MLB All-Star Game. Ginny attempts to balance her career and personal life. The Padres are blindsided when Oscar signs a star catcher from Cuba.

translations.value: Mike sustains an injury that threatens his spot in the MLB All-Star Game. Ginny attempts to balance her career and personal life. The Padres are blindsided when Oscar signs a star catcher from Cuba.

episodes.name: Wear it
episodes.plot: Upon signing a huge deal with Nike, Ginny feels an overwhelming sense of pressure, which leads to a night of rebellion and a mandatory session with a therapist.

translations.value: Upon signing a huge deal with Nike, Ginny feels an overwhelming sense of pressure, which leads to a night of rebellion and a mandatory session with a therapist.

episodes.name: San Francisco
episodes.plot: Oscar informs Mike that during their game in San Francisco, Duarte will be the catcher. He assures Mike, he is not on his way out. Mike recalls a moment from his past. Amelia tries to find a way to fix Ginny's video.

translations.value: Oscar informs Mike that during their game in San Francisco, Duarte will be the catcher. He assures Mike, he is not on his way out. Mike recalls a moment from his past. Amelia tries to find a way to fix Ginny's video.

episodes.name: Unstoppable Forces & Immovable Objects
episodes.plot: A rain delay at Petco Park causes the team to hold Kangaroo Court in the clubhouse in order to pass the time. Meanwhile, per Oscar's suggestion, Mike mulls over the option of trading to a new team, and an unexpected visit from Ginny's brother, Will, causes friction with Amelia.

translations.value: A rain delay at Petco Park causes the team to hold Kangaroo Court in the clubhouse in order to pass the time. Meanwhile, per Oscar's suggestion, Mike mulls over the option of trading to a new team, and an unexpected visit from Ginny's brother, Will, causes friction with Amelia.

episodes.name: Scratched
episodes.plot: Mike becomes the biggest news story in the MLB when rumors start about him waiving his no-trade clause. Meanwhile, Evelyn and Will go in on a business venture together, but Amelia is concerned that it relies too heavily on Ginny's fame.

translations.value: Mike becomes the biggest news story in the MLB when rumors start about him waiving his no-trade clause. Meanwhile, Evelyn and Will go in on a business venture together, but Amelia is concerned that it relies too heavily on Ginny's fame.

episodes.name: Don't Say It
episodes.plot: Ross warns the Padres that Ginny is dangerously close to her pitching limit, but management is reluctant to end her season.

translations.value: Ross warns the Padres that Ginny is dangerously close to her pitching limit, but management is reluctant to end her season.
